data.description: This spell functions like a fly spell, except you can fly at a speed of 40 feet [30 feet if wearing medium or heavy armor, or if carrying a medium or heavy load] with a bonus on Fly skill checks equal to half your caster level. When using this spell for long-distance movement, you can hustle without taking nonlethal damage [a forced march still requires Constitution checks]. This means you can cover 64 miles in an 8-hour period of flight [or 48 miles at a speed of 30 feet].
